title: Confined Space Entry Risk Assessment
description: Free Confined Space Entry Risk Assessment template for oil & gas you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers confined space information, confined space identification and evaluation, confined space entry risk assessment matrix
standard: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.146 - API RP 2217 - Industry Best Practice
topics: Confined Space Entry Risk Assessment Matrix

DOES IT HAVE ANY OF THESE HAZARDS? (If YES to any, it's a PERMIT-REQUIRED confined space)

HAZARDYESNOCOMMENTS / CONTROL MEASURES

CLASSIFICATION:

☐ PERMIT-REQUIRED CONFINED SPACE (PRCS) - Entry requires permit and all PRCS procedures

☐ NON-PERMIT CONFINED SPACE - No atmospheric or other hazards; entry without permit may be allowed

☐ RECLASSIFIED TO NON-PERMIT - All hazards eliminated; documentation attached

☐ ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURES - Only atmospheric hazards; continuous monitoring and ventilation
